title.zh: KŪKAI 空海 — 放映与对谈

location.en: Anthropology & Art Practice Building, Room 160 · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 Anthropology & Art Practice Building · 160 教室

description.en: A documentary on Kūkai’s journey from Japan to Tang China, followed by an online conversation with director Yue Ye. Co-hosted with C. V. Starr East Asian Library and Deep Value. Classical Chinese narration with English subtitles; film runtime: 97 minutes.
description.zh: 纪录片讲述空海自日本赴唐的旅程，并与导演岳野在线对谈。由 C. V. Starr 东亚图书馆、大同学社与 Deep Value 合办。文言旁白，英文字幕，片长 97 分钟。

title.en: A Conversation with Laura Wen-yu Young
title.zh: 与 Laura Wen-yu Young 对谈

location.en: Seminar Room 341, C. V. Starr East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 C. V. Starr 东亚图书馆 · 341 研讨室

description.en: Datong Society and the East Asian Library hosted Laura Wen-yu Young of Wang and Wang, LLP for an evening of remarks and open discussion.
description.zh: 大同学社与东亚图书馆共同举办 Laura Wen-yu Young（Wang and Wang, LLP）对谈，活动包含嘉宾分享与开放讨论。
